detaljer: Exact whole BACK VIEW impact phase 1811. Human Lee-Harvey directly away in dark navy jacket/trousers, gray-blue shoulder/cuffs, brown quiff back and pink ears, straight narrow legs and dark boots. He holds Max horizontally across behind his head: rabbit ears hang down-left from pink left hand, small cream head and tiny dark eye peek left of hair, hidden body behind hair, two cream feet at far right in right grip. Unlike preceding phase there is NO raised fist above human head. Instead preserve EXACTLY TWO pale YELLOW irregular cartoon impact stars high above-left of hair, with the thin separate yellow trailing broken lines pointing downward, the small yellow radiating ticks beside the hair, and the few WHITE zigzag impact strokes just above-left of hair. Keep all original stars, broken strokes and dots at their original relative positions, colors and sizes. Do not turn them into water, white droplets, an orbit ring or extra stars. No extra exposed rabbit arm, tail, floor, Sam fragments, belly button or new facial details. Paint the whole scene cel together on transparency with exact source pose/spacing and clean flat colors.
